_note: Where each shipped recitation starts saying the text, which lines it says, and which it says more than once -- all taken by ear. `seconds`: how far in the first word of the text is spoken. `lines`: the 1-based line ranges the recitation covers, for a recording that leaves a stretch out; lines outside them keep their text and get no timing. `repeat`: [first, last, times] for lines the reciter says twice, common at the close of a bani. `skipAudio`: stretches of the recording filled with something the text does not carry. `pin`: a line held to the second somebody heard it start. `hold`: lines to leave exactly where the warp put them, which stops a pin's stretch spreading across the whole recitation. Nothing is ever cut from a recording.
